 Follow ‘Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping' adds special early screenings. Here's where in the Bay Area
 Zara Irshad Thu, November 12, 2026 at 9:38 PM UTC 2 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. The Bay Area movie theaters will be screening "The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping" at sunrise later this month. (Vivien Killilea/Getty Images for Lionsgate) Rise and shine, tributes. More than 130 movie theaters are opening early for fans eager to see "Sunrise on the Reaping," the latest installment in "The Hunger Games" franchise.
 Lionsgate is hosting a series of sunrise screenings of the film at 7 a.m. Nov. 21, the morning after its nationwide release. Participating locations in the Bay Area include Regal Stonestown Galleria in San Francisco, Regal Hacienda Crossings in Dublin and Santa Clara's AMC Mercado 20.
 More Information 
 "The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping"
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement (PG-13) early morning screenings begin at 7 a.m. Nov. 21 in select Bay Area theaters.
 Special screenings at Regal and Phoenix theaters will offer limited supplies of flint striker pins, while some cinemas will have other merchandise giveaways and special breakfast foods to enjoy during the film.
 Tickets are available now.
 Fans are encouraged to wear pajamas, a nod to original Haymitch Abernathy actor Woody Harrelson's now-iconic pajama outfit that he wore to the 2015 photo call for "The Hunger Games: Mockingjay - Part 2" premiere in Paris. The ensemble, a grey long sleeve T-Shirt and plaid pants, has since become a meme online.
 Advertisement Advertisement A prequel to the original trilogy, "Sunrise on the Reaping" is set 24 years before the events of "The Hunger Games" (2012) and follows a young Haymitch Abernathy (Joseph Zada) through the 50th Quarter Quell games. The film also stars McKenna Grace, Ralph Fiennes and Jesse Plemons.
 It was adapted from Suzanne Collins' 2025 book of the same name and is the second prequel film in the franchise. The first, 2023's "The Ballad of Songbirds and Snakes," focused on antagonist President Snow (Tom Blyth) in his youth. It also starred Rachel Zegler, Hunter Schafer and Viola Davis.
 Fans of the dystopian franchise are particularly excited for the "Sunrise on the Reaping" because it will reunite the two main stars of the original films: Jennifer Lawrence and Josh Hutcherson. The two will reprise their roles as Katniss and Peeta for a flash-forward epilogue scene.
